image_description: A close-up photograph of a small, slender snake with glossy, reddish-brown scales coiled on the edge of a white surface. The snake's body is cylindrical and smooth, lacking distinct patterning. The head is rounded and blends seamlessly into the neck, consistent with burrowing species. The background is blurred, focusing attention on the texture and form of the snake.
